definitions.text_mt: Fiswa li ma tagħmilx ħoss.
Persuna li tindaħal f'affarijiet ta' ħaddieħor.

usage_examples.mt: Il-kelb għamel fiswa u ħarab.
usage_examples.en: The dog made a noiseless fart and ran away.

usage_examples.mt: Tkunx fiswa, ħalli lin-nies jgħixu ħajjithom.
usage_examples.en: Don't be a meddler, let people live their lives.

definitions.text_mt: Idawwar ħajt jew ħabel ma' xulxin biex jgħoqdu.
Isir fietel wara li kien sħun.

usage_examples.mt: Ftilna l-ħabel biex norbot il-pakkett.
usage_examples.en: We twisted the rope to tie the package.

usage_examples.mt: Il-kafè ftel u ma ridtx nixrob iktar.
usage_examples.en: The coffee went lukewarm and I did not want to drink any more.

usage_examples.mt: Filt il-ħajt qabel ma daħħaltu fil-labra.
usage_examples.en: He twisted the thread before threading the needle.

definitions.text_mt: Kunjom.

usage_examples.mt: Is-Sur Fiteni għandu ħanut fil-belt.
usage_examples.en: Mr Fiteni has a shop in the city.

usage_examples.mt: Il-familja Fiteni ilha tgħix f'dan ir-raħal għal ġenerazzjonijiet.
usage_examples.en: The Fiteni family has been living in this village for generations.

definitions.text_mt: Ifittex xi ħaġa li ntefgħet jew intilfet.
Jipprova jsib xi ħaġa.
Ifittex b'attenzjoni.

usage_examples.mt: Fittixt il-ċwievet imma ma sibthomx.
usage_examples.en: I searched for the keys but I did not find them.

usage_examples.mt: Il-pulizija fittxet id-dar kollha.
usage_examples.en: The police searched the whole house.

usage_examples.mt: Qed infittxu persuna li taf titkellem bil-Malti għax-xogħol.
usage_examples.en: We are seeking a person who can speak Maltese for the job.

definitions.text_mt: Idaħħal fixla jew konfużjoni f'moħħ xi ħadd.

usage_examples.mt: L-istorbju fixelni waqt li kont qed nistudja.
usage_examples.en: The noise disturbed me while I was studying.

usage_examples.mt: Il-kompitu kien tant diffiċli li fixel lill-istudenti kollha.
usage_examples.en: The task was so difficult that it confused all the students.

definitions.text_mt: Iwaqqaf jew ixekkel il-progress ta' xi ħadd.
Idaħħal konfużjoni jew tfixkil f'xi ħaġa.

usage_examples.mt: Il-karozza mkissra fixklet it-traffiku għal sigħat.
usage_examples.en: The broken car obstructed traffic for hours.

usage_examples.mt: Il-bidliet f'daqqa fixklu l-pjanijiet tagħna.
usage_examples.en: The sudden changes disrupted our plans.

usage_examples.mt: Tfixkilx lil ħuk waqt li jkun qed jaħdem.
usage_examples.en: Do not hinder your brother while he is working.

definitions.text_mt: Stat ta' konfużjoni jew diżordni.

usage_examples.mt: Kien hemm fixla kbira fis-suq meta nxterdet l-aħbar.
usage_examples.en: There was great confusion in the market when the news spread.

usage_examples.mt: Fixla qabdet lil kulħadd meta nqalgħet il-ġlieda.
usage_examples.en: Confusion took hold of everyone when the fight broke out.

definitions.text_mt: Ħaxix mill-ġeneru Raphanus b'għerq li jittiekel nej fl-insalati.

usage_examples.mt: Illum xtrajt fiġel mis-suq għall-insalata.
usage_examples.en: Today I bought radishes from the market for the salad.

usage_examples.mt: Fiġel huwa tajjeb għas-saħħa għax fih ħafna vitamini.
usage_examples.en: Radish is good for health because it contains many vitamins.

usage_examples.mt: Il-familja tagħna tħawwel fiġel fil-ġnien kull sena.
usage_examples.en: Our family plants radishes in the garden every year.

definitions.text_mt: Jirriżulta li huwa utli jew ta' benefiċċju maż-żmien.

usage_examples.mt: L-esperjenza li kiseb fjadlu ħafna fil-karriera tiegħu.
usage_examples.en: The experience he gained proved very useful in his career.

usage_examples.mt: Il-parir li tana n-nannu fjadna iktar tard.
usage_examples.en: The advice our grandfather gave us proved useful later on.

definitions.text_mt: Li m'għandux saħħa jew enerġija.
Li għandu aptit qawwi għall-ikel.
Li ma jurix interess jew ħeġġa.

usage_examples.mt: Wara l-marda, ħassejtni fjakk ħafna.
usage_examples.en: After the illness, I felt very weak.

usage_examples.mt: Jien fjakk, meta se jkun lest l-ikel?
usage_examples.en: I am hungry, when will the food be ready?

usage_examples.mt: Huwa fjakk lejn kollox, xejn ma jgħoġbu.
usage_examples.en: He is apathetic towards everything, nothing pleases him.

definitions.text_mt: Għasfur kbir b'riġlejn twal u rix roża li jgħix qrib l-ilma.

usage_examples.mt: Rajna fjamingu fil-bajja l-bieraħ.
usage_examples.en: We saw a flamingo in the bay yesterday.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fjamingi jieklu l-alka u l-krustaċji żgħar.
usage_examples.en: Flamingos eat algae and small crustaceans.

usage_examples.mt: Is-salina kienet mimlija fjamingi roża.
usage_examples.en: The salt pan was full of pink flamingos.

definitions.text_mt: Sħaba ta' nar li titla' minn xi ħaġa li qed taħraq.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fjamma tal-kandla kienet tixgħel bil-mod.
usage_examples.en: The flame of the candle was burning slowly.

usage_examples.mt: Oqgħod attent mill-fjamma, tmissx in-nar.
usage_examples.en: Be careful of the flame, do not touch the fire.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fjammi nqabżu malajr u ħarqu l-injam kollu.
usage_examples.en: The flames spread quickly and burned all the wood.

definitions.text_mt: Iż-żmien meta l-pjanti joħorġu l-fjuri.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fjoritura tas-siġar tal-larinġ tibda fir-rebbiegħa.
usage_examples.en: The blossoming of the orange trees begins in spring.

usage_examples.mt: Din is-sena l-fjoritura kienet sabiħa ħafna.
usage_examples.en: This year the blossoming was very beautiful.

definitions.text_mt: Pjanta li tipproduċi fjuri.
L-istruttura riproduttiva ta' pjanta li ħafna drabi jkollha petali kuluriti.

usage_examples.mt: Ġabli fjuri sbieħ għal għeluq snini.
usage_examples.en: He brought me beautiful flowers for my birthday.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fjur tal-ġiżimin għandu riħa sabiħa u qawwija.
usage_examples.en: The jasmine flower has a beautiful and strong scent.

usage_examples.mt: Fjur tal-larinġ ifisser li dalwaqt se jkollna frott.
usage_examples.en: An orange blossom means we will soon have fruit.

definitions.text_mt: Pjanta tal-fjuri mill-ġeneru Iris b'weraq twal u fjuri kkuluriti.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fjurduliż isfar jikber ħdejn l-għadajjar.
usage_examples.en: The yellow iris grows near ponds.

usage_examples.mt: F'ġnien nannti hemm ħafna fjurduliż ta' kull kulur.
usage_examples.en: In my grandmother's garden there are many irises of every colour.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fjurduliż huwa l-fjura nazzjonali ta' Malta.
usage_examples.en: The iris is the national flower of Malta.

definitions.text_mt: Pjanta tal-fjuri b'fjuri bojod li ħafna drabi tinstab fiċ-ċimiterji.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fjurduliż abjad jitħawwel ħafna fl-oqsma ta' madwar iċ-ċimiterji.
usage_examples.en: The cemetery iris is often planted in the fields around cemeteries.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fjuri bojod tal-fjurduliż abjad ifissru l-paċi.
usage_examples.en: The white flowers of the cemetery iris symbolise peace.

definitions.text_mt: Pjanta tal-fjuri b'fjuri blu jew vjola li titkabbar fil-ġonna.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fjurduliż ikħal huwa wieħed mill-isbaħ fjuri fil-ġnien fir-rebbiegħa.
usage_examples.en: The German iris is one of the most beautiful flowers in the garden in spring.

usage_examples.mt: Il-ġirien tagħna għandhom fjurduliż ikħal tul il-ħajt kollu.
usage_examples.en: Our neighbours have German irises along the whole wall.

definitions.text_mt: Pjanta tal-fjuri bi fjuri sofor u kannella li tikber fis-salv.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fjurduliż imżewwaq jikber b'mod naturali fil-mergħat tal-Ewropa.
usage_examples.en: Iris variegata grows naturally in the meadows of Europe.

usage_examples.mt: Il-kuluri differenti tal-fjurduliż imżewwaq jagħmluha faċli biex tagħrafha.
usage_examples.en: The different colours of Iris variegata make it easy to recognise.

definitions.text_mt: Pjanta tal-fjuri b'fjuri sofor li tikber f'artijiet niedja u max-xmajjar.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fjurduliż isfar jikber max-xmajjar u fil-bassasiet.
usage_examples.en: The yellow flag grows along rivers and in marshes.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fjuri sofor tal-fjurduliż isfar jidhru mill-bogħod.
usage_examples.en: The yellow flowers of the yellow flag can be seen from afar.

definitions.text_mt: Pjanta tal-fjuri bi fjuri kbar ta' lewn griż u iswed b'marki skuri.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fjurduliż ittigrat ġej mill-Lvant Nofsani u għandu fjuri kbar ħafna.
usage_examples.en: The mourning iris comes from the Middle East and has very large flowers.

usage_examples.mt: Il-kulur skur tal-fjurduliż ittigrat jagħtih isem il-luttu.
usage_examples.en: The dark colour of the mourning iris gives it its name.

definitions.text_mt: Pjanta tal-fjuri bi fjuri lelà li għandhom riħa ħelwa u qawwija.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fjurduliż Sqalli jintuża fil-perfumija għar-riħa ħelwa tiegħu.
usage_examples.en: The sweet iris is used in perfumery for its sweet scent.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fjuri lelà tal-fjurduliż Sqalli huma spettakolari fil-ġnien.
usage_examples.en: The lilac flowers of the sweet iris are spectacular in the garden.

definitions.text_mt: Pjanta tal-fjuri bi fjuri kbar ta' lewn griż u iswed, sinonimu ta' fjurduliż ittigrat.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fjurduliż ta' Farawni huwa fjura rari li tinsab fil-gżejjer Maltin.
usage_examples.en: The mourning iris is a rare flower found in the Maltese islands.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fjurduliż ta' Farawni jiffjorixxi f'April u Mejju.
usage_examples.en: The mourning iris blossoms in April and May.

definitions.text_mt: Pjanta tal-fjuri b'fjuri sofor li tikber fl-artijiet niedja u max-xmajjar.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fjurduliż tal-ilma jikber max-xmajjar u fil-bassasiet.
usage_examples.en: The yellow flag grows along rivers and in marshes.

usage_examples.mt: Wara x-xita, il-fjurduliż tal-ilma jiffjorixxi mal-kosta kollha.
usage_examples.en: After the rain, the yellow flag blossoms all along the coast.

definitions.text_mt: Pjanta tal-fjuri bi fjuri blu jew lelà li titkabbar fil-ġonna.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fjurduliż tal-ġonna jiffjorixxi fir-rebbiegħa u jdum sular ix-xahar.
usage_examples.en: The Spanish iris blossoms in spring and lasts about a month.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fjuri blu tal-fjurduliż tal-ġonna huma perfetti għall-fjuri maqtugħin.
usage_examples.en: The blue flowers of the Spanish iris are perfect for cut flowers.

definitions.text_mt: Waħda mill-erba' simboli tal-karti tal-logħob, imsejħa wkoll fjuri.
Aktar minn fjura waħda.

usage_examples.mt: Huwa lagħab il-fjuri u rebaħ il-logħba.
usage_examples.en: He played clubs and won the game.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fjuri huma wieħed mill-erba' simboli fil-karti Franċiżi.
usage_examples.en: Clubs are one of the four suits in French playing cards.

usage_examples.mt: Il-ġnien tagħna huwa mimli fjuri sbieħ fir-rebbiegħa.
usage_examples.en: Our garden is full of beautiful flowers in spring.
